hero_lead: Our range has expanded from fresh produce origins into a comprehensive food supply offering — fresh, frozen, dairy and grocery, all through a single relationship.
fresh_intro: Supplied through certified supply chains for retail, catering and export buyers.
citrus_body: Citrus is the foundation of Bungle's produce expertise. We bring exceptional industry experience in Australian citrus and table grapes — built over 15+ years of marketing, exporting and post-harvest science. We market and export premium Australian citrus year-round, with the variety depth to supply customers across every month of the season.
growers_heading: A fresh produce business — built alongside our growers.
growers_body_1: Fresh produce is where Bungle began, and it remains the heart of who we are. We wouldn't be where we are today without our growers — partners we've grown alongside and walked this path with, season after season, hand in hand.
growers_body_2: Our teams are constantly on the road through Australia's growing regions, and our office sits in Mildura, in the heart of the nation's food bowl. That keeps us present on the ground — close to the fruit, the farm and the season — working every day for both our customers and our growers.
growers_body_3: Our role is a simple one: put the right fruit in the hands of the right customer. The best price point for the customer, and the best return for the grower. We sit between the two, and we look after both.
frozen_heading: A comprehensive frozen range for catering and institutional buyers.
frozen_body: Sourced from leading international and Australian frozen-food manufacturers, with cold-chain integrity maintained throughout.
dairy_heading: A full dairy range, cold-chain assured.
dairy_body: For catering, retail and institutional buyers — sourced from Australian and international producers with cold-chain certification throughout the supply chain.
fmcg_heading: Branded and private-label grocery for the Pacific.
fmcg_body: A wide range of major international and Australian FMCG brands across grocery staples, supplied to catering, retail and hospitality channels across PNG and the Pacific.
